title: QA report is bound to turns.json only by turn COUNT; clamped/dropped/overshoot and stale same-count QA do not fail
evidence: Attack harness (tmp roots, durationSec injected): stale transcript-qa.json with outputCount==turn count PASSES; QA with clampedCount=20, dropped=5, overshootSec=400 PASSES; overlapping and swapped (non-monotonic) turns PASS unless the QA file says so (validateTurns and assertTurnTimings check neither, same as submit.mjs/transcribe flow); 75 identical-text turns PASS with no QA file and LKB_TRANSCRIPT_QA unset. Mutations of qa.nonMonotonic>0, qa.durationValid!==true and assertTurnTimings step all SURVIVE validate-session.test.mjs (0 failures). turnsSha256 is recorded but transcript-qa.json carries no hash to compare it with.
fix_direction: Have transcribe write turnsSha256 into transcript-qa.json and compare in qaEvidence; recompute monotonic/overlap and repeated-run checks from turns in the validator rather than trusting the QA file; decide whether clamped>0/dropped>0 should fail or be recorded; add tests killing the three survivors.

title: --accept-partial has no coverage floor and the sync gate ignores partial (POLICY QUESTION for Umesh)
evidence: Harness: 25 of 75 turns (coverage 0.332) PASSES with acceptPartial; a single 1-turn transcript (coverage 0.0122) and a single 0-1s turn (coverage 0.0011) PASS. validation.json records partial:true, partialAccepted:true, coverage, gaps, so downstream CAN see it, but session-rows.mjs:45 reads only status and transcriptValidated, so loadWebinarSession accepts and sync proceeds.
fix_direction: Umesh to decide: refuse partial at the sync gate unless a separate explicit flag, and/or require a minimum coverage (or an explicit --min-coverage) for --accept-partial.
